notes.title: New Level! Inferno and Halloween!
notes.content:
Taking advantage of the month of Halloween, Infinity Valley now comes with amazing new spooky levels! The addition of Hell's Valley and Halloween is now online!

Together there are also new cars with new stats and great new gameplay!
